selection: One fixed F16/F20 profile, no training, tuning or precision search. First8 previously used holdout windows per corpus; explicitly implementation conformance, not independent blind quality evidence.
limits: Public Pythia14M FP32 CUDA backbone and logits. Integer adapter is evaluated openly for conformance; no private arithmetic, acceptance, end-to-end latency or novelty claim. Empirical checks apply to reused windows; analytical error certificate is conditional on the declared real input domain. Supporting finite realization of bounded private sampling, not a dedicated quantization research direction.
